about.title: Overly Complex processOrder with Redundant Conditions and Nested Logic
about.description: This function calculates an order total but is intentionally hard to maintain due to deep nesting, repeated checks, duplicated condition branches, and unnecessary boolean patterns. It mixes validation, pricing, discounts, tax, logging, and size classification in one block. It includes logic smells such as duplicated premium and country checks, === true comparisons, and nested threshold checks that increase cognitive complexity. It is a good refactoring exercise to practice guard clauses, helper extraction, deduplication, and clearer business-rule separation while preserving behavior.
